Nutrient composition and RDI — Timor's own, deliberately

Source: R/nutrients.R
nutrients.Rd

Renamed from R/calculate-nutrients.R in migration Phase 8. The plan's §4b test was "delete Timor's if it agrees with coasts::enrich_taxa()", and it fails on four counts, measured in Phase 4 and restated in .claude/migration/COASTS-4.6.0.md: coasts emits six nutrients against Timor's seven, has no selenium, does no unit conversion (Timor's convert = TRUE normalises mg/μg/g per 100 g to grams), and carries no FAO food-composition override for the six invertebrates FishBase cannot estimate (OCZ, IAX, COZ, PEZ, CRA, SLV) or the hardcoded FLY row. Nothing below changed with the rename; upstreaming it is Phase 10.

Developed by Lorenzo Longobardi, Fernando Cagua, Hamza Altarturi.
